affected consumer surface

  • CURIE: gmeow:affectedConsumerSurface
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/affectedConsumerSurface
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/narrative

The projection consumer surfaces that a myth tends to leak into — e.g. Wikipedia, public site, agent memory — so that a correction can be scoped to the surfaces that actually carry the bad claim. Reuses the gmeow:ProjectionContext vocabulary.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Myth -> gmeow:ProjectionContext

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:affectedConsumerSurface from gmeow:Myth to gmeow:ProjectionContext when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Myth, gmeow:ProjectionContext

Generated from the GMEOW ontology. Canonical source is RDF/OWL; this site is a deterministic projection.
